slotNote: Budget, execution and the schedule network are computed by the server from the recorded lines, dates and durations on every read. Nothing here is a business approval.
readOnly: You can read this section. Changing it needs a permission you do not hold here.

budget.title: Budget lines
budget.intro: Budget, actual and forecast per line, as decimal amounts in the line's own currency. An empty amount is Unknown, never 0. Totals are per currency and never converted between currencies.
budget.addIntro: The line's currency is your organization's default currency when the line is created, and it cannot be changed afterwards.
budget.archiveBody: An archived line leaves the totals and can no longer be changed. Give the reason.
budget.emptyBody: This initiative has no budget lines yet, so its budget is Unknown (not 0).

field.label: Line label
field.periodMonthHint: Year and month as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-11. Leave empty for the whole initiative.
field.amountHint: Zero or more, with Latin digits and a dot, for example 1250000.50. Leave empty when the amount is not known (Unknown, never 0).

totals.title: Totals per currency
totals.noLinesBody: The budget is Unknown: this initiative has no active budget lines.
totals.noneKnown: No line has this amount yet
totals.caption: Totals in {{currency}}

execution.title: Execution
execution.intro: Approved and forecast milestone dates with the slip in working days on the organization's business calendar, deliverable acceptance, capacity and FTE demand, dependencies and decisions, read from their records.
execution.criticalPathUnknown: No critical path can be computed yet (see the schedule network).

slip.onTime: On the approved date (0 working days)

reason.calendar_not_configured: No business calendar is configured for the organization
reason.range_too_long: The dates are too far apart to count working days

demand.title: Capacity and FTE demand
demand.noCapacity: No capacity recorded for this role and month

direction.outgoing: Another initiative depends on this one

network.title: Schedule network and critical path
network.intro: The transformation's initiatives (not cancelled) linked by their dependencies as finish-to-start, with planned durations in working days. The critical path is computed with the critical path method (zero total float); it is only claimed when every initiative has a duration.

reason.missing_durations: Some initiatives have no planned duration. Record a duration for each one listed below; until then no initiative or dependency is marked critical.
reason.no_initiatives: This transformation has no initiatives to schedule.
reason.cycle: The dependencies form a cycle, so no schedule can be computed.

network.truncated: More than 20 critical paths exist; the first 20 are listed.
network.noEdges: No dependency links two initiatives of this transformation.
network.offsetsNote: Starts and finishes are working-day offsets from the start of the network (day 0).

duration.title: Planned duration of this initiative
duration.none: No planned duration is recorded for this initiative.
duration.fieldHint: A whole number from 0 to 2600. Leave empty when it is not known yet (then no critical path is claimed).
